cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
include(GNUInstallDirs)

# ── Guard: NSX board flags must be defined ────────────────────────────────
if(NOT DEFINED NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "hkv_arrhythmia_aot: NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET is not defined.\n"
        "This module requires the NSX build system. Use --module.type=cmake for standalone builds.")
endif()

# ── Static library (shared boilerplate from macros.j2) ────────────────────
add_library(hkv_arrhythmia_aot STATIC)

target_compile_features(hkv_arrhythmia_aot PUBLIC c_std_99)

target_include_directories(hkv_arrhythmia_aot PUBLIC
  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/includes-api>
  $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/nsx/modules/hkv_arrhythmia_aot/includes-api>
)

# ── NSX alias / export name ───────────────────────────────────────────────
set_target_properties(hkv_arrhythmia_aot PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME hkv_arrhythmia_aot)
add_library(nsx::hkv_arrhythmia_aot ALIAS hkv_arrhythmia_aot)

# ── Dependencies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
target_link_libraries(hkv_arrhythmia_aot
    PUBLIC
        ${NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET}
        nsx::cmsis_nn
)

# ── Memory placement override hook ────────────────────────────────────────
# Consumers (e.g. heliaPROFILER) can set this to a header that redefines
# the HKV_ARRHYTHMIA_PUT_IN_* macros with real section attributes.
# The header is force-preincluded so it takes effect before platform.h's
# #ifndef guards.
if(DEFINED HKV_ARRHYTHMIA_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER)
    if(EXISTS "${HKV_ARRHYTHMIA_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}")
        target_compile_options(hkv_arrhythmia_aot PUBLIC
            "-include${HKV_ARRHYTHMIA_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}"
        )
    else()
        message(WARNING
            "hkv_arrhythmia_aot: attributes header not found: "
            "${HKV_ARRHYTHMIA_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}")
    endif()
endif()

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/includes-api
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/nsx/modules/hkv_arrhythmia_aot)
install(TARGETS hkv_arrhythmia_aot EXPORT nsxTargets)
